links.text: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?
links.author: David

links.text: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
links.author: Matthew

phrases.note: The Latin immensus means “without measure”: not held within any place. The 1662 “incomprehensible” carries that older sense.

phrases.en: The Father eternal, the Son eternal: and the Holy Ghost eternal.
phrases.orig: Æternus Pater: æternus Filius: æternus et Spiritus Sanctus.

links.text: But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:
links.author: Paul

links.text: How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
links.author: the writer of Hebrews

links.text: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.
links.author: Moses

links.text: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.
links.author: John

links.text: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
links.author: John

phrases.en: And yet they are not three eternals: but one eternal.
phrases.orig: Et tamen non tres æterni: sed unus æternus.

links.text: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD:
links.author: Moses

links.text: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
links.author: Paul

phrases.en: As also there are not three incomprehensibles, nor three uncreated: but one uncreated, and one incomprehensible.
phrases.orig: Sicut non tres increati: nec tres immensi: sed unus increatus: et unus immensus.

links.text: But will God indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house that I have builded?
links.author: Solomon

links.text: Thus saith the LORD the King of Israel, and his redeemer the LORD of hosts; I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no God.
links.author: Isaiah

phrases.en: So likewise the Father is Almighty, the Son Almighty: and the Holy Ghost Almighty.
phrases.orig: Similiter omnipotens Pater: omnipotens Filius: omnipotens et Spiritus Sanctus.

links.text: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.
links.author: Paul

links.text: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
links.author: John

links.text: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
links.author: Matthew

links.text: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.
links.author: Luke

links.text: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.
links.author: Paul

phrases.en: And yet they are not three Almighties: but one Almighty.
phrases.orig: Et tamen non tres omnipotentes: sed unus omnipotens.

links.text: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the LORD appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.
links.author: Moses

links.text: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.
links.author: John

phrases.en: So the Father is God, the Son is God: and the Holy Ghost is God.
phrases.orig: Ita Deus Pater: Deus Filius: Deus et Spiritus Sanctus.

links.text: But to us there is but one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we in him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, by whom are all things, and we by him.
links.author: Paul

links.text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
links.author: John

links.text: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.
links.author: John

links.text: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost, and to keep back part of the price of the land? Whiles it remained, was it not thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thine own power? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.
links.author: Luke

links.text: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;
links.author: Paul

phrases.en: And yet they are not three Gods: but one God.
phrases.orig: Et tamen non tres dii: sed unus est Deus.

links.text: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD:
links.author: Moses

links.text: As concerning therefore the eating of those things that are offered in sacrifice unto idols, we know that an idol is nothing in the world, and that there is none other God but one.
links.author: Paul

links.text: Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.
links.author: James

links.text: I am the LORD, and there is none else, there is no God beside me: I girded thee, though thou hast not known me:
links.author: Isaiah

phrases.en: So likewise the Father is Lord, the Son Lord: and the Holy Ghost Lord.
phrases.orig: Ita Dominus Pater: Dominus Filius: Dominus et Spiritus Sanctus.

links.text: At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.
links.author: Matthew

links.text: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
links.author: Paul

links.text: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
links.author: Paul

phrases.en: And yet not three Lords: but one Lord.
phrases.orig: Et tamen non tres domini: sed unus est Dominus.

links.text: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,
links.author: Paul

links.text: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD:
links.author: Moses

links.text: But to us there is but one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we in him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, by whom are all things, and we by him.
links.author: Paul

phrases.en: For like as we are compelled by the Christian verity: to acknowledge every Person by himself to be God and Lord;
phrases.orig: Quia sicut singulatim unamquamque personam Deum ac Dominum confiteri, Christiana veritate compellimur:

links.text: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.
links.author: John

links.text: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost, and to keep back part of the price of the land? Whiles it remained, was it not thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thine own power? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.
links.author: Luke

links.text: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
links.author: Paul

phrases.en: So are we forbidden by the Catholick Religion: to say there be three Gods, or three Lords.
phrases.orig: Ita tres deos, aut tres dominos dicere, catholica religione prohibemur.

links.text: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.
links.author: Moses

links.text: Thus saith the LORD the King of Israel, and his redeemer the LORD of hosts; I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no God.
links.author: Isaiah

links.text: For though there be that are called gods, whether in heaven or in earth, (as there be gods many, and lords many,) But to us there is but one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we in him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, by whom are all things, and we by him.
links.author: Paul

phrases.en: The Father is made of none: neither created, nor begotten.
phrases.orig: Pater a nullo est factus: nec creatus, nec genitus.

links.text: But to us there is but one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we in him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, by whom are all things, and we by him.
links.author: Paul

links.text: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.
links.author: Moses

links.text: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;
links.author: John

phrases.en: The Son is of the Father alone: not made, nor created, but begotten.
phrases.orig: Filius a Patre solo est: non factus, nec creatus: sed genitus.

links.text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
links.author: John

links.text: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.
links.author: John

links.text: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.
links.author: John

links.text: I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.
links.author: David

links.text: But thou, Beth–lehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.
links.author: Micah

phrases.en: The Holy Ghost is of the Father and of the Son: neither made, nor created, nor begotten, but proceeding.
phrases.orig: Spiritus Sanctus a Patre et Filio: non factus, nec creatus, nec genitus: sed procedens.

links.text: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:
links.author: John

links.text: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.
links.author: Paul

links.text: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.
links.author: John

links.text: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.
links.author: Paul

phrases.note: The Latin says “of the Father and of the Son”. This creed was written in the West; the Orthodox, who confess that the Spirit proceeds from the Father (John 15:26), do not use it.

phrases.en: So there is one Father, not three Fathers; one Son, not three Sons: one Holy Ghost, not three Holy Ghosts.
phrases.orig: Unus ergo Pater, non tres patres: unus Filius, non tres filii: unus Spiritus Sanctus, non tres spiritus sancti.

links.text: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling; One Lord, one faith, one baptism, One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.
links.author: Paul

links.text: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit. And there are differences of administrations, but the same Lord. And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same God which worketh all in all.
links.author: Paul

phrases.en: And in this Trinity none is afore, or after other: none is greater, or less than another;
phrases.orig: Et in hac Trinitate nihil prius, aut posterius: nihil majus, aut minus.

links.text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
links.author: John

links.text: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:
links.author: Paul

links.text: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.
links.author: John

links.note: “My Father is greater than I”: the creed reads it of his manhood (verse 33).
links.text: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.
links.author: John

phrases.en: But the whole three Persons are co-eternal together: and co-equal.
phrases.orig: Sed totæ tres personæ coæternæ sibi sunt, et coæquales.

links.text: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:
links.author: Paul

links.text: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.
links.author: John

links.text: How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
links.author: the writer of Hebrews

phrases.en: So that in all things, as is aforesaid: the Unity in Trinity, and the Trinity in Unity is to be worshipped.
phrases.orig: Ita, ut per omnia, sicut jam supra dictum est: et Unitas in Trinitate, et Trinitas in Unitate, veneranda sit.

links.text: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
links.author: Matthew

links.text: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.
links.author: John

links.note: The church has long heard the three “Holy”s as the Trinity; the verse itself does not say so.
links.text: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is the LORD of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory.
links.author: Isaiah

phrases.en: He therefore that will be saved: must thus think of the Trinity.
phrases.orig: Qui vult ergo salvus esse, ita de Trinitate sentiat.

links.text: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.
links.author: John

links.text: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: [but] he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.
links.author: John

links.text: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.
links.author: John

phrases.note: These warnings split the Church of England in the 1860s and 1870s, and the Episcopal Church in the United States never used this creed in worship. The verses show where Scripture itself joins salvation to faith.

phrases.en: Furthermore it is necessary to everlasting salvation: that he also believe rightly the Incarnation of our Lord Jesus Christ.
phrases.orig: Sed necessarium est ad æternam salutem: ut incarnationem quoque Domini nostri Jesu Christi fideliter credat.

links.text: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:
links.author: John

links.text: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
links.author: John

links.text: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.
links.author: John

phrases.en: For the right Faith is that we believe and confess: that our Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of God, is God and Man;
phrases.orig: Est ergo fides recta, ut credamus et confiteamur: quod Dominus noster Jesus Christus Dei Filius, Deus pariter et homo est;

links.text: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
links.author: Paul

links.text: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
links.author: Matthew

links.text: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
links.author: Paul

links.text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
links.author: John

phrases.en: God, of the Substance of the Father, begotten before the worlds: and Man, of the Substance of his Mother, born in the world;
phrases.orig: Deus est ex substantia Patris, ante secula genitus: et homo ex substantia matris, in seculo natus.

links.text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
links.author: John

links.text: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;
links.author: the writer of Hebrews

links.text: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,
links.author: Paul

links.text: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.
links.author: Luke

links.text: But thou, Beth–lehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.
links.author: Micah

phrases.en: Perfect God, and Perfect Man: of a reasonable soul and human flesh subsisting;
phrases.orig: Perfectus Deus: perfectus homo, ex anima rationali et humana carne subsistens.

links.text: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.
links.author: Paul

links.text: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.
links.author: the writer of Hebrews

links.text: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.
links.author: Matthew

links.text: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.
links.author: Luke

links.text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
links.author: John

phrases.en: Equal to the Father, as touching his Godhead: and inferior to the Father, as touching his Manhood.
phrases.orig: Æqualis Patri secundum divinitatem: minor Patre secundum humanitatem.

links.text: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:
links.author: Paul

links.note: “My Father is greater than I”: the creed reads it of his manhood.
links.text: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.
links.author: John

links.text: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.
links.author: John

links.text: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.
links.author: the writer of Hebrews

phrases.en: Who although he be God and Man: yet he is not two, but one Christ;
phrases.orig: Qui licet Deus sit et homo; non duo tamen, sed unus est Christus.

links.text: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
links.author: Paul

links.text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
links.author: John

links.text: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.
links.author: Paul

links.text: But to us there is but one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we in him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, by whom are all things, and we by him.
links.author: Paul

phrases.en: One, not by conversion of the Godhead into flesh: but by taking of the Manhood into God;
phrases.orig: Unus autem, non conversione divinitatis in carnem: sed assumptione humanitatis in Deum.

links.text: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:
links.author: Paul

links.text: For verily he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.
links.author: the writer of Hebrews

links.text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
links.author: John

phrases.en: One altogether, not by confusion of Substance: but by unity of Person.
phrases.orig: Unus omnino; non confusione substantiæ: sed unitate personæ.

links.text: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.
links.author: Paul

links.text: Concerning his Son Jesus Christ our Lord, which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh; And declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead:
links.author: Paul

links.note: “God was manifest in the flesh” follows the later manuscripts; the oldest read “He who was manifested”.
links.text: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
links.author: Paul

phrases.en: For as the reasonable soul and flesh is one man: so God and Man is one Christ.
phrases.orig: Nam sicut anima rationalis et caro unus est homo: ita Deus et homo unus est Christus.

links.text: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
links.author: Paul

links.text: And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
links.author: Moses

links.text: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
links.author: Paul

phrases.en: Who suffered for our salvation: descended into hell, rose again the third day from the dead.
phrases.orig: Qui passus est pro nostra salute: descendit ad inferos: tertia die resurrexit a mortuis.

links.text: And said unto them, Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day:
links.author: Luke

links.text: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:
links.author: Paul

links.text: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?
links.author: Paul

links.text: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
links.author: the writer of Hebrews

links.text: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;
links.author: Peter

links.text: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
links.author: David

phrases.note: “Descended into hell” is disputed; see the Apostles' Creed, article 5, for the ways churches read it.

phrases.en: He ascended into heaven, he sitteth on the right hand of the Father, God Almighty: from whence he shall come to judge the quick and the dead.
phrases.orig: Ascendit ad cœlos: sedet ad dexteram Dei Patris omnipotentis. Inde venturus est judicare vivos et mortuos.

links.text: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)
links.author: Paul

links.text: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.
links.author: Paul

links.text: I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;
links.author: Paul

links.text: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.
links.author: Luke

links.text: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.
links.author: Luke

links.text: A Psalm of David. The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
links.author: David

phrases.en: At whose coming all men shall rise again with their bodies: and shall give account for their own works.
phrases.orig: Ad cujus adventum omnes homines resurgere habent cum corporibus suis; et reddituri sunt de factis propriis rationem.

links.text: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.
links.author: Paul

links.text: But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ’s at his coming.
links.author: Paul

links.text: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
links.author: Matthew

links.text: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,
links.author: John

links.text: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.
links.author: Paul

links.text: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
links.author: Daniel

phrases.en: And they that have done good shall go into life everlasting: and they that have done evil into everlasting fire.
phrases.orig: Et qui bona egerunt, ibunt in vitam æternam: qui vero mala, in ignem æternum.

links.text: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.
links.author: John

links.text: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.
links.author: Matthew

links.text: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:
links.author: Matthew

links.text: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
links.author: Daniel

phrases.note: Close to word for word from John 5:29 and Matthew 25:46 in the Latin Bible the creed's author read.

phrases.en: This is the Catholick Faith: which except a man believe faithfully, he cannot be saved.
phrases.orig: Hæc est fides catholica: quam nisi quisque fideliter firmiterque crediderit, salvus esse non poterit.

links.text: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.
links.author: John

links.text: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.
links.author: John

links.text: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
links.author: the writer of Hebrews

links.text: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.
links.author: Luke

phrases.note: These warnings split the Church of England in the 1860s and 1870s, and the Episcopal Church in the United States never used this creed in worship. The verses show where Scripture itself joins salvation to faith.

left_out.note: Often set beside these lines. It stands in the longer ending of Mark, which the oldest manuscripts lack.
left_out.text: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.
